title: Setup: run rdf4j #1989's landed empty-group aggregate tests at both revisions
description: Setup for case L09 of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-l01-l20-brief.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/worktrees (L09-rdf4j-fix = 1767ceebe5d309238263bdca732b730cc47b3e45, L09-rdf4j-parent = c2c7a5265e6c40bc5dc2574260c96c3e10f9a87c), builds rdf4j's compliance/sparql module with everything it depends on (-pl compliance/sparql -am, JDK 8, Maven 3.9.9 checked against Maven Central's sha512 and the Apache Maven KEYS: Maven 3.10.0 rejects a duplicate dependency in compliance/repository/pom.xml) and runs the landed tests: MemoryComplexSPARQLQueryTest (the memory-store subclass of ComplexSPARQLQueryTest, which gains six Max/Min/Sample empty-group tests), the new SPARQL12QueryTest (agg-empty-group-1/2 manifest) and GroupIteratorTest. On the fix online (one connector thread, Maven Central) then offline; on the parent its own tests offline; then every test-side file of the PR checked out from the fix onto the parent, production code unchanged (expected: some of the new tests fail). Also copies the module jars of both sides to the cache and compares them class by class. The whole -am chain (including the HTTP server war) is why this is a job. Logs and JUnit summaries to ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/logs; worktrees restored and cleaned. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-l01-l20-brief-setup.md.
expected: every step exits 0: the fix's three test classes pass online and offline, the parent's own pass, the transplant prints TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED (or TRANSPLANT-DOES-NOT-COMPILE) with production-unchanged

steps.name: L09 fix: build compliance/sparql with -am and run MemoryComplexSPARQLQueryTest, SPARQL12QueryTest, GroupIteratorTest, online
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; source $HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/scripts/env.sh; mkdir -p $O/tmp $O/logs $O/artifacts; cd $W/L09-rdf4j-fix; echo worktree=L09-rdf4j-fix commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD); set +e; XMX=-Xmx2g $O/scripts/rdf4j_B.sh L09-rdf4j-fix L09-fix.compliance-online compliance/sparql MemoryComplexSPARQLQueryTest,SPARQL12QueryTest,GroupIteratorTest online; set -e; test $(grep -o 'tests=[0-9]*' $O/logs/L09-fix.compliance-online.junit.txt | head -1 | cut -d= -f2) -gt 0; test $(grep -o 'failures=[0-9]*' $O/logs/L09-fix.compliance-online.junit.txt | head -1 | cut -d= -f2) -eq 0; test $(grep -o 'errors=[0-9]*' $O/logs/L09-fix.compliance-online.junit.txt | head -1 | cut -d= -f2) -eq 0; echo PASS-CHECK-OK $O/logs/L09-fix.compliance-online.junit.txt;

steps.name: L09 fix: the same, offline
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; source $HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/scripts/env.sh; mkdir -p $O/tmp $O/logs $O/artifacts; cd $W/L09-rdf4j-fix; echo worktree=L09-rdf4j-fix commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD); set +e; XMX=-Xmx2g $O/scripts/rdf4j_B.sh L09-rdf4j-fix L09-fix.compliance-offline compliance/sparql MemoryComplexSPARQLQueryTest,SPARQL12QueryTest,GroupIteratorTest ; set -e; test $(grep -o 'tests=[0-9]*' $O/logs/L09-fix.compliance-offline.junit.txt | head -1 | cut -d= -f2) -gt 0; test $(grep -o 'failures=[0-9]*' $O/logs/L09-fix.compliance-offline.junit.txt | head -1 | cut -d= -f2) -eq 0; test $(grep -o 'errors=[0-9]*' $O/logs/L09-fix.compliance-offline.junit.txt | head -1 | cut -d= -f2) -eq 0; echo PASS-CHECK-OK $O/logs/L09-fix.compliance-offline.junit.txt;

steps.name: L09 parent: its own MemoryComplexSPARQLQueryTest and GroupIteratorTest, offline
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; source $HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/scripts/env.sh; mkdir -p $O/tmp $O/logs $O/artifacts; cd $W/L09-rdf4j-parent; echo worktree=L09-rdf4j-parent commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD); set +e; XMX=-Xmx2g $O/scripts/rdf4j_B.sh L09-rdf4j-parent L09-parent.compliance-offline compliance/sparql MemoryComplexSPARQLQueryTest,GroupIteratorTest ; set -e; test $(grep -o 'tests=[0-9]*' $O/logs/L09-parent.compliance-offline.junit.txt | head -1 | cut -d= -f2) -gt 0; test $(grep -o 'failures=[0-9]*' $O/logs/L09-parent.compliance-offline.junit.txt | head -1 | cut -d= -f2) -eq 0; test $(grep -o 'errors=[0-9]*' $O/logs/L09-parent.compliance-offline.junit.txt | head -1 | cut -d= -f2) -eq 0; echo PASS-CHECK-OK $O/logs/L09-parent.compliance-offline.junit.txt;

steps.name: L09 jars of every module built at both pins, and their class comparison
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; source $HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/scripts/env.sh; mkdir -p $O/tmp $O/logs $O/artifacts; for r in parent fix; do d=$O/artifacts/L09-rdf4j-$r-modules; mkdir -p $d; find $W/L09-rdf4j-$r -path '*/target/rdf4j-*-3.1.2-SNAPSHOT.jar' ! -name '*-tests.jar' ! -name '*-sources.jar' -exec cp {} $d/ \; ; ls $d | wc -l; (cd $d && sha256sum *.jar) > $O/logs/L09-rdf4j-$r-modules.sha256; done; for j in $O/artifacts/L09-rdf4j-fix-modules/*.jar; do b=$(basename $j); python3 -I $O/scripts/jarcmp_B.py $O/artifacts/L09-rdf4j-parent-modules/$b $j | head -1 | sed "s#^#$b parent-vs-fix: #"; done > $O/logs/L09-modules-parent-vs-fix.txt; grep -v 'differ=0 ' $O/logs/L09-modules-parent-vs-fix.txt || true;

steps.name: L09 parent with the PR's test-side files transplanted (production code unchanged), offline: new tests expected to fail
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; source $HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/scripts/env.sh; mkdir -p $O/tmp $O/logs $O/artifacts; cd $W/L09-rdf4j-parent; echo worktree=L09-rdf4j-parent commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD); FIX=$(git -C $W/L09-rdf4j-fix rev-parse HEAD); git checkout $FIX -- compliance/sparql/src/test/java/org/eclipse/rdf4j/query/parser/sparql/manifest/SPARQL12QueryTest.java compliance/sparql/src/test/java/org/eclipse/rdf4j/query/parser/sparql/manifest/W3CApprovedSPARQL11QueryTest.java compliance/sparql/src/test/java/org/eclipse/rdf4j/query/parser/sparql/manifest/W3CApprovedSPARQL11UpdateTest.java compliance/sparql/src/test/java/org/eclipse/rdf4j/sail/federation/FederationSPARQL11QueryTest.java compliance/sparql/src/test/java/org/eclipse/rdf4j/sail/nativerdf/NativeSPARQLQueryTest.java core/queryalgebra/evaluation/src/test/java/org/eclipse/rdf4j/query/algebra/evaluation/iterator/GroupIteratorTest.java testsuites/sparql/src/main/java/org/eclipse/rdf4j/query/parser/sparql/ComplexSPARQLQueryTest.java testsuites/sparql/src/main/java/org/eclipse/rdf4j/query/parser/sparql/manifest/SPARQL11ManifestTest.java testsuites/sparql/src/main/resources/testcases-sparql-1.1-w3c/aggregates/manifest.ttl testsuites/sparql/src/main/resources/testcases-sparql-1.2; git status --short; git diff --cached --quiet -- core/queryalgebra/evaluation/src/main && echo production-unchanged; set +e; XMX=-Xmx2g $O/scripts/rdf4j_B.sh L09-rdf4j-parent L09-parent.transplanted.compliance-offline compliance/sparql MemoryComplexSPARQLQueryTest,SPARQL12QueryTest,GroupIteratorTest ; set -e; if grep -q -E 'COMPILATION ERROR|Compilation failure' $O/logs/L09-parent.transplanted.compliance-offline.log; then echo TRANSPLANT-DOES-NOT-COMPILE; grep -E '\[ERROR\].*\.java' $O/logs/L09-parent.transplanted.compliance-offline.log | head -40 || true; else test $(grep -o 'tests=[0-9]*' $O/logs/L09-parent.transplanted.compliance-offline.junit.txt | head -1 | cut -d= -f2) -gt 0; test $(( $(grep -o 'failures=[0-9]*' $O/logs/L09-parent.transplanted.compliance-offline.junit.txt | head -1 | cut -d= -f2) + $(grep -o 'errors=[0-9]*' $O/logs/L09-parent.transplanted.compliance-offline.junit.txt | head -1 | cut -d= -f2) )) -gt 0; echo TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED; fi; git reset -q; git checkout -- .; git clean -fdq; git status --short;

steps.name: remove the build trees
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; source $HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/scripts/env.sh; mkdir -p $O/tmp $O/logs $O/artifacts; git -C $W/L09-rdf4j-fix checkout -- .; git -C $W/L09-rdf4j-fix clean -fdxq; git -C $W/L09-rdf4j-fix status --short; git -C $W/L09-rdf4j-parent checkout -- .; git -C $W/L09-rdf4j-parent clean -fdxq; git -C $W/L09-rdf4j-parent status --short; du -sh $W/L09-rdf4j-fix $W/L09-rdf4j-parent
